messages.displayText: The next day...
Your alarm is going off...

Ah, that old room of mine is the best! Felt like AZ
was still here, welcoming me back.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕƒ

The hotel where I reside is so decadent that I can
never quite feel relaxed there.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕƥ

You come from one fancy family, Ansha!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕƒ

are bespoke, if I’m not mistaken.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+000B>

Y’know, in all this craziness, I forgot to ask...<U+0010><U+0001>븁

the time, Ansha?<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+000C>

know about your donut shop and everything?<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕƒ

bedtime.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕƥ

Will you be needing a room?

discuss this a little more calmly?<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+000B>

At this rate, I’m riskin’ the wrath of Lady Jacinthe,
and it’s NOT gonna be pretty!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0016>

I think you’ll be able to explain the situation
better if you take a deep breath.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+000B>

Lady Jacinthe has a close friend, whom she
deeply respects and admires.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
The daughter of that friend has been staying at
Hotel Richissime.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0016>

I was tasked with acting both as bodyguard and
babysitter during her stay...but now she’s GONE!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0016>
MISS ANSHAAA!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0016>
Where are youuu?!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0016>
Here. Like I said.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0012>
Our mission is complete. I’m leaving now.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0012>
OH NO, YOU’RE NOT!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0016>

I’ve been so worried about Miss Ansha and what

Canatic.<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0012>

I’ll take my leave. Best of luck—and work hard at

All right, time to head back!<U+0010><U+0002>Ĕ<U+0016>
